type2_diabetes.overview: Nutritional management focuses on glycaemic control, weight management, and cardiovascular risk reduction.

targets.daily_calories: Individualised; typically 1500-2000 kcal for weight loss
targets.carbohydrates_pct: 45-60% of total calories; prioritise low-GI sources

recommended_foods: Whole grains (oats, barley, quinoa, brown rice)
Lean proteins (chicken breast, turkey, fish, tofu)
Nuts and seeds (almonds, walnuts, chia seeds)
foods_to_limit: Refined carbohydrates (white bread, white rice, pastries)
Sugary beverages (soda, fruit juice, energy drinks)
High-GI fruits (watermelon, pineapple in large amounts)
type2_diabetes.meal_timing: Consistent meal times; avoid skipping meals; small frequent meals preferred

drug_interactions.interaction: Long-term Metformin use can deplete B12; monitor and supplement if needed
Alcohol combined with sulfonylureas increases hypoglycemia risk

hypertension.overview: DASH (Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension) diet is the gold standard evidence-based dietary intervention.
foods_to_limit: High-sodium processed foods and canned goods

drug_interactions.interaction: ACE inhibitors raise potassium levels; avoid high-potassium supplements and monitor intake
Consistent Vitamin K intake is essential; avoid sudden large changes in intake
Grapefruit and grapefruit juice inhibit CYP3A4, dramatically increasing statin blood levels. AVOID completely.

chronic_kidney_disease.overview: Dietary management aims to slow disease progression and manage complications of declining kidney function.
recommended_foods: White bread and white rice (lower phosphorus/potassium than whole grain)

drug_interactions.interaction: Take with meals; avoid high-phosphorus foods to maximise efficacy
Monitor calcium and phosphorus levels closely

high_cholesterol.overview: Therapeutic Lifestyle Changes (TLC) diet reduces LDL cholesterol by 20-30%.
recommended_foods: Oats, barley, and other whole grains (beta-glucan soluble fiber)
Fruits rich in pectin (apples, pears, citrus)

drug_interactions.interaction: CRITICAL: Grapefruit inhibits CYP3A4 enzyme, raising statin concentrations and risk of myopathy/rhabdomyolysis. Avoid entirely.
Alcohol combined with niacin therapy increases flushing and liver toxicity risk
